name: Adimmune Corporation
summary: Adimmune Corporation engages in the development, manufacture, and distribution of vaccines and other biological products in Taiwan, the United States, China, and internationally. The company offers AdimFlu-S, a quadrivalent influenza vaccine; suspensions for injection influenza vaccines; and tetanus toxoid alum precipitated product for the prevention of tetanus after injury. It also develops AdimrSC-2f, a subunit protein-based vaccine for the prevention of COVID-19; H5N1 vaccine; and cell culture-derived Japanese encephalitis vaccine.
